title: Looking Up in Prague
description: David Černý's "Hanging Man" suspended above a narrow street.
altText: A bronze sculpture of a man in a suit holding a briefcase and hanging by one hand from a red umbrella, suspended high above a street corner next to a historic building in Prague.

title: Morning Light over Old Town Square
description: Baroque façades enclosing the city's central square.
altText: A view of Prague's Old Town Square showing the historic bronze Jan Hus Memorial statue in the foreground, flanked by ornate, colourful historic buildings with red roofs under a bright blue sky.

title: Tracking Time in Old Prague
description: The Astronomical Clock layered with carved motion and detail.
altText: Extreme close-up of the medieval Prague Astronomical Clock showing its detailed blue and gold astronomical dial, the calendar dial below it, and decorative gothic sculptures on the stone tower.

title: Silent Tunnels
description: Stone archways formed from carefully arranged remains within Sedlec Ossuary.
altText: A dark stone archway tightly lined and framed entirely by hundreds of stacked human skulls and bones, with four distinct skulls sitting on a wooden ledge in the foreground.

title: Whispers of the Past
description: Bone structures arranged into intricate interior forms.
altText: A close-up, low-angle shot inside the Sedlec Ossuary showing a pillar stacked with human skulls and crossbones, with a large, ornate bone chandelier hanging in the background.

title: Spires and Skulls
description: The Gothic exterior of the Bone Church, simple at a distance, precise in detail up close.
altText: The stone facade and towers of the Sedlec Ossuary chapel against a blue sky, featuring prominent gold skull-and-crossbones emblems atop the spires and a statue of the Virgin Mary.

title: A Splash of Yellow
description: Ornate clockwork set against a sunlit façade.
altText: An intricate black wrought-iron clock with gold accents and decorative script hanging from the corner of a bright yellow historic building adorned with flower boxes.

title: Melodies in the Courtyard
description: Street musicians performing in the courtyard of U Fleků.
altText: Musicians performing in the tree-shaded courtyard of the U Fleků brewery beer garden in Prague, with historic buildings and outdoor seating in the background.

title: Tracks and Taps
description: Model trains delivering drinks through Výtopna.
altText: A model train carrying small glasses of beer along miniature railway tracks built into the wooden bar counter at the Výtopna Railway Restaurant in Prague.

title: All Aboard for Dinner
description: Miniature rail systems running between tables.
altText: A perspective view along the model train tracks running through the interior of the Výtopna Railway Restaurant in Prague, with tables and diners alongside the rails.

title: Gothic Dreams
description: Twin spires of the Church of Our Lady before Týn.
altText: The dark Gothic twin spires and ornate facade of the Church of Our Lady before Týn dominating the skyline above colourful historic rooftops in Prague's Old Town.

title: A Cobblestone Florist
description: Flowers spilling from a weathered green storefront.
altText: A charming rustic florist storefront with a green-painted facade, flower boxes, and bouquets displayed outside on a cobblestone street in Prague.

title: Chasing the Red Trams
description: A vintage tram passing through tight streets.
altText: A classic red and cream Prague tram turning along a cobblestone street lined with historic buildings and overhead wires.

title: Reaching for the Sky
description: The Old Town Hall tower rising into open sky.
altText: A dramatic low-angle shot looking up the ornate Gothic tower of Prague's Old Town Hall against a vivid blue sky.
